messages.content: Delete yesterday's strength session and move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday

content.text:
I can't do either of these. My Garmin access is read-only, so I can look at your activities and calendar but can't delete activities or move scheduled workouts. I found both items, so here's how to change them yourself in Garmin Connect:

**1. Delete yesterday's strength session**
- **Activity:** "Strength session", Tue 17 Mar, 07:10, 30 min (ID 8880001**2**)
- **How:** Open the activity, tap the ⚙️ or ⋯ menu, then choose **Delete Activity**.
- **Careful:** You also have an "Endurance ride" from yesterday evening at 18:05. Make sure you delete the strength session and not the ride.

**2. Move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday**
- **Workout:** "Threshold intervals 5x6", Thu 19 Mar, about 80 min / 13.2 km
- **How:** On the **web calendar**, drag it from Thursday to Friday. In the **app**, open the workout on the calendar, use the ⋯ menu to remove it from Thursday, then schedule it again on Friday 20 Mar.
- **Note:** There's also a "Technique swim" scheduled tomorrow. It will stay on Thursday unless you move it too.

Friday has nothing else scheduled, so the run won't share the day with another workout.
